subject: Genetics
title: Genetic Determination Myth
description: Learn Genetic Determination Myth in one minute.

hook.text: Your genes don't determine your destiny.

buildup.text: Most traits are polygenic: influenced by hundreds of genes, each contributing a tiny effect. Plus environment.

discovery.text: Identical twins share 100% of DNA but differ in personality, disease risk, and life outcomes. Genes are not fate.

twist.text: The 'gene for X' headline is almost always wrong. There's no single gene for intelligence, depression, or criminality.

climax.text: Genetic determinism is comforting but false. Biology sets ranges; experience fills them. You are not your genome alone.

punchline.text: Genes load the dice. Life rolls them.

quiz.question: Why don't identical twins have identical life outcomes?
options: Environment and chance also shape outcomes
